issues: vimeo.com/<id> (non-channel URL) serves a Cloudflare/Vimeo human-verification challenge to curl; not bypassed. Channel URLs vimeo.com/channels/pain/<id> returned HTTP 200 with full metadata and were used.

player.vimeo.com/video/<id>/config returned HTTP 403 for the sampled video (domain-restricted); player pages also 403. Captions/text tracks and chapters could not be inspected; transcript_available recorded as unknown for all 57.

All 57 clips have no uploader description (Vimeo boilerplate only; v2 API description empty and no tags for the 36 ids where it responded; 21 ids returned 404 from the v2 API, cause unknown). Therefore no summaries, concepts, techniques, objectives or cautions could be source-grounded; they are empty rather than invented.

Audience cannot be confirmed from page/description for any series; only the channel description (self-management in partnership with health care providers) was inspected. Title-only hints: PainBytes adolescent-oriented; SCI series population-specific.

Probable duplicate: TMP-aci-0017 (E5 - Intro Pain and School, 87386798, 51 s, uploaded 2014-02-23) vs TMP-aci-0037 (Episode 5 - Introduction Pain and School, 87921789, 51 s, uploaded 2014-03-01): same title stem and duration; identical content not verified.
Possible overlap: TMP-aci-0018 (Episode 2 intro) and TMP-aci-0014 (Episode 2 Segment 3) are both exactly 110 s; not verified.

Series gaps: PainBytes Episode 5 has Segments 4-7 only (Segments 1-3 absent); Episode 3 has Segments 1-3; SCI series has Episodes 1, 2, 4, 6, 7 only (3 and 5 absent). Items listed in the channel are 57 (matches channel count).

Ordering/format oddities: Episode 1 Segment 5 (87046092) is listed out of order; "Episode 4 Segment 5 - Relaxation Techniques and Mindfulness" (53 s) is an overview of 5A-5D, which are child parts; inconsistent title formatting ("Segment 1-" etc.).

Inventory ids/titles all matched live page titles after removing the Vimeo suffix " in Chronic Pain"; 0 mismatches. Durations from the pages replace the null durations in inventory. Upload dates are 2014-02-17 to 2014-07-31 (content is ~12 years old; currency of clinical info unverified, e.g. medication videos).
